name: GD Power Development Co.,Ltd
summary: GD Power Development Co.,Ltd operates as a power generation company in China. It operates through four segments: Thermal Power Generation, Hydropower Generation, New Energy Power Generation, and Other Segments. Its total installed capacity is approximately 3.89 billion kilowatts. GD Power Development Co.,Ltd was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. GD Power Development Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of China Energy Investment Corporation Limited.
